body.name: Total concentration calendar-block interval
body.construction:
Put \(\alpha_{\mathrm{st}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}=\alpha/2\). On the regular branch, let \(w_{st}\) be the actual response weight obtained by averaging the selected foldwise intercept weights. Define
\[
A_w=\sum_{s=1}^{S}\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\left(1+\sum_{t=1}^{T}|w_{st}|\right)^2,
\qquad
M_w=\max_{1\le s\le S}\frac{\pi_s}{n_s}\left(1+\sum_{t=1}^{T}|w_{st}|\right),
\]
and
\[
r_{\mathrm{unit}}=B\{8A_w\log(8/\alpha_{\mathrm{st}})\}^{1/2}+\frac{8B}{3}M_w\log(8/\alpha_{\mathrm{st}}).
\]
Using the complete retained blocks \(J_k\) separated by gaps of length \(a_T\), form cross-fitted block scores with the actual weights. Let \(\mathcal G_T\) be the set of discarded and incomplete-block indices, and put
\[
L_k=4B\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\sum_{t\in J_k}|w_{st}|,
\qquad
L_{\mathcal G}=2B\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_s\sum_{t\in\mathcal G_T}|w_{st}|.
\]
Define
\[
x_{\mathrm{cal}}=\inf\left\{x\ge0:
4\exp\left(-\frac{2x^2}{\sum_{k=1}^{K_T}L_k^2}\right)
+2SK_T\beta_0\rho_0^{a_T}\le\alpha_{\mathrm{st}}/2\right\},
\]
with the usual convention when all \(L_k=0\), and let
\[
r_B=B\left\{8\log(16/\alpha_{\mathrm{st}})\sum_s\frac{\pi_s^2}{n_s}\right\}^{1/2}
+\frac{8B}{3}\log(16/\alpha_{\mathrm{st}})\max_s\frac{\pi_s}{n_s},
\qquad
r_{\mathrm{cal}}=r_B+L_{\mathcal G}+x_{\mathrm{cal}}.
\]
If the defining set for \(x_{\mathrm{cal}}\) is empty, declare the calendar branch unusable. This is an explicit scalar optimization and uses neither an estimated variance nor division. Since both concentration constructions are valid, put \(r_{\mathrm{samp}}=r_{\mathrm{unit}}\wedge r_{\mathrm{cal}}\). For \(N\ge2\), spectrally clip the full donor covariance estimator to \([c_\Sigma/2,2C_\Sigma]\), and set
\[
q_{\mathrm{don}}=\left\{\frac{32SdC_\Sigma}{c_\Sigma\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}}\right\}^{1/2}.
\]
Define
\[
r_{\mathrm{bias}}=C_H\sum_{s=1}^{S}\pi_sK_N^{-1}\sum_{\ell=1}^{K_N}\left(\|\widehat u_{s\ell}-\widetilde z_{\ell s}\|_2^\kappa+\widehat h_{s\ell}^{\lambda}\right),
\qquad
r_{\mathrm{don}}=C_H(q_{\mathrm{don}}/\sqrt N)^\kappa,
\]
and
\[
R_\alpha=r_{\mathrm{samp}}+r_{\mathrm{bias}}+r_{\mathrm{don}},
\qquad
C_\alpha=[\widehat\tau-R_\alpha,\widehat\tau+R_\alpha]\cap[-2B,2B].
\]
If \(N<2\), some \(n_s<2\), fewer than two usable retained blocks exist, a cross-fit is empty, the calendar coupling budget is nonpositive, a candidate set \(\mathcal A_{s\ell}\) is empty, or any numerical input is undefined or nonfinite, set \(C_\alpha=[-2B,2B]\). Hence no sample variance is divided by, and the bounded-range correction is explicit.
